1170-3581-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-7918.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5879-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2933-4499-5434-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

4487-5660-7388.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

765-1558-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1394-2060-4772-5147-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doubling Season.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doubling Season.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

4779-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4779-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1563-3490-7075-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-7075-7296.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1339-4063-6625-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

457-5078-5390-6556.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

11-5195-6106-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-5195-6106-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Electroduplicate, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Electroduplicate, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Electroduplicate
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Electroduplicate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Electroduplicate to your hand and creating a copy of Electroduplicate targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Electroduplicate copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Electroduplicate.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-3769-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2034-3769-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

465-719-969-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-969-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

428-1694-3769-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-3769-5361.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

751-1418-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
751-1418-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3000-4506-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-4506-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

703-3129-4313.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Primal Vigor tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

175-3525-4207.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3525-4207.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

1692-2341-2743-5277.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
Abstruse Archaic and The Peregrine Dynamo do not have summoning sickness.
1692-2341-2743-5277.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

776-1329-2915-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2915-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Lodestone Bauble to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Lodestone Bauble.
Cast Lodestone Bauble.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1462-2517-5299.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling a permanent you control.
Activate Parallax Wave again by removing a fade counter from it, targeting a permanent an opponent controls.
In response, activate Parallax Wave again by removing a fade counter from it, exiling itself.
Parallax Wave's last ability triggers, returning itself and other permanents exiled by Parallax Wave to the battlefield.
Let the remaining ability resolve, permanently exiling the permanent your opponent controls.
Repeat.

651-4046-4595.notablePrerequisites: Garruk, Apex Predator must have at least 3 loyalty.
651-4046-4595.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Activate Garruk's -3 ability destroying Task Force, gaining life equal to its toughness.
